translationRepairs: Jia Sheng already declined went, heard Changsha low wet, self thought longevity not long, moreover banished went, intention not self satisfied.
Jia Sheng already took leave and departed; heard Changsha was low and damp; thought to himself longevity would not be long; moreover went away in banishment; his spirits were not at ease.

In 賈生既辭往行, 辭往行 means he took leave and set out for Changsha after being appointed Taifu; rendering 辭 as “declined” invents a refusal the Chinese does not support. The proposed literal correctly restores leave-taking and keeps the rest aligned with 聞長沙卑溼, 自以壽不得長, 又以適去, and 意不自得.
This time Qu Ping already alienated, no longer in position, sent to Qi, looked back, advised Huai Wang said: 'Why not kill Zhang Yi?'
This time Qu Ping already alienated, no longer in position, sent to Qi; upon returning, advised Huai Wang said: 'Why not kill Zhang Yi?'

In 使於齊，顧反，諫懷王曰, 顧反 is the classical idiom “return / come back,” not a physical looking back; the next clause (remonstrating with King Huai to kill Zhang Yi) follows that return. Replacing “looked back” with “upon returning” corrects the mistranslation without changing attribution or content.
